## Forms · Submit HR Verification → `n8n_submitHrVerification(actor, data, include)`
Real `submitHRVerification` (sheet *HR Verification Results*; also overwrites Initial Requests name/manager/title columns). Contract is **verified in r2** (was unverified in r1).
**Required:** `workflowId firstName lastName managerName managerEmail jobTitle adpAssociateId`
**Optional:** `hireDate(yyyy-MM-dd) jrTitle(reference.jrs; UI-required when the request's JR Req = Yes) siteName(reference.sites) department notes`; `formId` via `extra`.
Stored as "jobTitle / jrTitle" in col 7. A second submit for the same workflow updates in place and sends **no** emails. The hidden internalEmployeeId is not posted.
**Access:** real session principal must be HR or Admin (`grp.forms.hr`). **Authorization ≠ attribution:** role checks run against the real Execution API session (`efx-bot@team-group.com`); `actor` is recorded for attribution only.

### Attribution
Pass `actor` from the calling workflow so Forms records who did it, e.g.
`{{ { id: 'n8n:' + $workflow.name, email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: $workflow.name + ' (n8n)' } }}`
If omitted the Router attributes the call to itself. `idempotencyKey` (optional) makes a retry replay the first result for 10 min.
Errors throw as `EFX <CODE>: message` — attach an error output or error workflow on the calling node.
